span.description: Number of printed pages this image covers. 1 for a single page, 2 for a two-page spread, 3 or more for a gatefold or foldout.

images.description: Localized final images for this page.

panels.description: Panels on this page, in reading order. Alt text for pages lives on panels.

chapter.description: AT-URI of the parent chapter. Use the DID form (at://did:...), not a handle.

versions.description: Other versions of the page's artwork, such as production stages or alternate treatments. AppViews may let readers peel back stages or switch between versions.

createdAt.description: The date and time the page was published. Set it when pages are released one at a time, so AppViews can index and order the page without fetching the chapter. Optional when the whole chapter is published at once; AppViews may ignore it and use the chapter's createdAt.

standalone.description: If true, readers always show this page on its own, never beside another page in a two-page layout.

aspectRatio.description: The aspect ratio of the page.

main.description: A page of a page formatted comic.
